bio.text: Susan Collins was elected to the U.S. Senate from Maine in 1996 and was re-elected in 2002, 2008, 2014 and 2020.
She was born in 1952 in Caribou, Maine, and graduated from St. Lawrence University in 1975.

Before the Senate she worked on the staff of Rep. and later Sen. William Cohen, served as Maine's commissioner of professional and financial regulation, and directed the Small Business Administration's New England regional office.
